_about: Upwork Project Catalog cut (must be 60 s or less) of the WhatsApp Commerce V2 video, built by bin/demo upwork (see README.md). Client-oriented: what was built, the real WhatsApp interaction, how it works, the operator dashboard (SYNTHETIC demo data, introduced by the 'Application demo · synthetic data' card and tagged DEMO DATA on every local frame), real verification and deployment. No contact details, no URLs, no logos, no evidence file names, no claim of long-term production reliability. Voice: Kokoro-82M af_heart at speed 0.95.

beats.text: Customers order from a catalog, right inside WhatsApp.
Here's a real conversation. The customer says hi and gets the catalog. They browse it inside WhatsApp, build a cart and send it. A receipt comes straight back.

beats.visual: how it works: webhook, persist, queue, process, validation, reply and status tracking
beats.text: Behind it, every webhook is verified, stored and acknowledged fast, then processed once in the background. Orders are checked against the catalog, and every reply is tracked.

beats.visual: application demo card (synthetic data), order detail with reply statuses, health page
beats.text: Here's the operator dashboard, with demo data: every order, each reply's delivery status, and anything that failed.
It's deployed over HTTPS, and was verified with real WhatsApp traffic, including a Meta error diagnosed from its stored details.
Ordering on WhatsApp, built to be operated.
